reason: The flowers are in dense racemes that are 'spikelike', so 'inflorescence spike-like' matches the text.

target: whole: involucre / cyathium (PO_0030126 cyathium as the containing part)
fix: In Euphorbia, 'glands N' follows 'Involucre ...' and counts the glands of one involucre (cyathium). A count after a semicolon inside a part's description should keep that part as the whole (bearer_container), as the 'N-flowered' counts already do.
reason: There are 5 glands on each cyathial involucre, not 5 on the plant. Without the container the count is false at plant level. A nectary class (PO_0009035) would also be a closer bearer than generic secretory tissue.
The perianth segments of the male flowers are slightly fleshy. Tepal plus fleshy is right. The degree word 'slightly' is not recorded, but that does not make the statement false.

target: cell (basal marginal lamina cells of the leaf)
fix: Moss and liverwort cell measurements ('... cells N × M µm') describe single lamina cells, not the leaf. 'X cells' plus a µm size should take the cell as bearer, with the leaf, its region (basal, margin) as the whole and position.
reason: 8 µm is the width of the basal marginal cells. A moss leaf 8 µm wide is plainly false.
The leaf blade's abaxial surface is smooth. The swap to leaf lamina abaxial epidermis is correct.
The leaf blade is sparsely pubescent on the adaxial side. The adaxial epidermis plus pubescent is right. 'Sparsely' is not recorded, but that is minor.

The receptacle is subglabrous or villous, and both values are kept as alternatives. In Eriocaulon this is the receptacle of the head, not a single flower's receptacle. PO has no inflorescence receptacle class, so PO_0009064 is acceptable.
The inflorescence is 2–4-flowered. Flowers per inflorescence 2–4, with inflorescence as container, is right.
'Ovules bisériés' means the ovules are in two rows. Biseriate is right.
The umbels are 4–9 cm across in flower, and the flowering-stage context is kept. The fruiting size (to 12 cm) is a separate statement.

The habit is either a perennial herb or a thinly woody shrub. Recording herbaceous vs frutescent as alternatives for the taxon is right. 'Thinly' would be better as 'slightly' than 'sparsely', but that is minor.

fix: 'X terminal and axillary' should give two annotations, terminal and axillary. Neither should be dropped.

The lamina is subleathery when dried. Coriaceous with 'approximately' and the 'dried' condition is right.

target: whole: glume (lower glume) for the veins
fix: In FlorML sections like 'Veins:' that follow a glume description, the veins belong to that glume. They should keep it as the whole and not become plant-level vascular bundles.

60–100 ft converts correctly to 18.3–30.5 m of plant height at maturity.

target: position: leaves on upper parts of branches
fix: A bracketed scope after a part name, as in 'Leaf-blades (on upper parts of branches)', should become a position slot on the bearer.

fix: 'glaucous' is being grounded as green (FLOPO_0988006). It means a waxy bloom and should map to PATO_0104277, as the 2026-11-14 union-pair rejections already note.
